name: video-recorder-extension
description: 1. Add the browser build `hls.min.js` from https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/releases beside `sidepanel.html`. 2. Open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer mode, and click **Load unpacked**. Select this folder. 3. Open your logged-in website in a normal HTTP(S) tab. 4. Click the extension icon to open the side panel. Click **Grant page access & scan active tab**, then approve the site's permission prompt. 5. Start or resume the video and scan again if needed. Click a detected playlist to attempt playback.
